name: Context Trees
changes: Unlinked mentions are now free. They no longer count text in URLs, external links, tags or code.
New settings for unlinked mentions: ignored terms, ignored folders, and a note property to opt a note out.
Sort the results by name or modified time, and turn on Remember the view state to keep the tab, sort and folds.
tip: Turn on Remember the view state in the settings to keep your folds and sort order between notes.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Context Trees is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it to find things in your vault.

related.name: Bases Link Graph
related.blurb: Draws the notes that a base selects as an interactive graph. Links become edges, and you click a node to open its note.
